questions.question: Monitoring va observability o'rtasidagi tub farq nima?
questions.explanation: Monitoring oldindan belgilangan metrikalarni statik chegaralarga nisbatan kuzatadi ("tizim ishlayaptimi?"). Observability — tizimning tashqi telemetriyasi (metrika, log, trace, profil) orqali ichki holatini aniqlash x...

questions.question: Observability'ning uch ustuni va ular incident paytida qanday bog'lanadi?
questions.explanation: Metrics: alert va dashboard uchun yengil time series (rate(http_requests_total[5m])).

questions.question: Google SRE'ning to'rt Golden Signal'ini tushuntiring.
questions.explanation: Latency: request'ga xizmat vaqti (muvaffaqiyatli va xatolilarni ajratib).

questions.question: RED va USE metodlarini solishtiring.
questions.explanation: RED (request asosidagi servislar): Rate, Errors, Duration.

questions.question: Prometheus nima va pull arxitekturasi qanday ishlaydi?
questions.explanation: Ochiq time-series DB va monitoring tizimi: service discovery (Kubernetes) orqali target'larni topib, ularning HTTP /metrics endpoint'laridan matn formatidagi metrikalarni muntazam "tortadi" (scrape) va lokal TSDB'da s...

questions.question: Prometheus'ning to'rt metrika turini tushuntiring.
questions.explanation: Counter: faqat o'sadigan (restart'da nolga tushadi) — http_requests_total; doim rate() bilan.

questions.question: Prometheus exporter nima?
questions.explanation: Prometheus formatini nativ chiqarmaydigan tizimlar telemetriyasini /metrics ga tarjima qiluvchi yengil agent (node_exporter, mysqld_exporter, blackbox_exporter).

questions.question: PromQL'da `rate()` va `irate()` farqi.
questions.explanation: rate(v[range]): butun oyna bo'yicha o'rtacha soniyalik o'sish — sakrashlar silliqlanadi. Alert va SLO uchun.

questions.question: PromQL'da `histogram_quantile()` p99 latency'ni qanday hisoblaydi?
questions.explanation: histogram_quantile(

questions.question: Metrikalarda high cardinality nima va nega Prometheus'ni yiqitadi?
questions.explanation: Cardinality — label kombinatsiyalaridan hosil bo'lgan unikal series soni. user_id, email, order_id kabi label'lar TSDB indeksi va xotirasini portlatadi — OOM. Bunday ma'lumot log yoki tracega tegishli, metrika label'i...

questions.question: Prometheus exemplar nima?
questions.explanation: Metrika sample'iga biriktirilgan aniq Trace ID — Grafana'da latency sakrashi nuqtasini bosib Tempo'dagi aynan o'sha trace'ni ochish.

questions.question: Grafana nima va zamonaviy observability'dagi roli?
questions.explanation: Turli manbalarga (Prometheus, Loki, Tempo, Elasticsearch, CloudWatch) ulanib yagona dashboard, alert va bog'langan telemetriya ko'rinishlarini beradigan ochiq vizualizatsiya platformasi.

questions.question: Alertmanager nima?
questions.explanation: Prometheus yuborgan alert'larni qabul qilib dedup, grouping, routing, inhibition va silencing qiladi, keyin PagerDuty, Slack, email'ga yuboradi.

questions.question: Alertmanager inhibition va grouping nima?
questions.explanation: Grouping: bog'liq alert'larni bitta xabarga jamlaydi (node'dagi 50 pod = 1 xabar).

questions.question: Loki nima va Elasticsearch'dan farqi?
questions.explanation: Elasticsearch: har log qatorining to'liq matnini indekslaydi (CPU va storage og'ir, lekin to'liq matnli qidiruv tez).

questions.question: LogQL nima?
questions.explanation: Log'lar uchun PromQL'ga o'xshash til:

questions.question: Grafana Tempo (monitoring kontekstida) nima?
questions.explanation: Span'larni arzon object storage'da (S3, GCS) saqlaydigan tracing backend; trace'lar log yoki metrikadan olingan trace_id bo'yicha (va TraceQL bilan) so'raladi.

questions.question: Uzoq muddatli Prometheus storage uchun Thanos va Mimir farqi.
questions.explanation: Thanos: Prometheus yonidagi sidecar block'larni S3'ga yuklaydi, Thanos Querier global so'rov beradi.

questions.question: OpenTelemetry (OTel) nima?
questions.explanation: Ko'p tilli tizimlarda telemetriyani (metrika, log, trace) yaratish, yig'ish, transformatsiya va eksport qilish uchun standart API, SDK va collector beradigan vendor-neytral CNCF framework.

questions.question: OTel Collector arxitekturasi (receiver, processor, exporter) qanday?
questions.explanation: Receiver: turli formatda qabul (OTLP, Prometheus, Jaeger).

questions.question: Distributed tracing'da span va trace farqi.
questions.explanation: Trace: request'ning servislar bo'ylab to'liq yo'li.

questions.question: W3C TraceContext nima?
questions.explanation: Servislar orasida uzatiladigan standart header'lar:

questions.question: Tail-based va head-based sampling farqi.
questions.explanation: Head-based: qaror request boshida (masalan tasodifiy 5%) — keyinroq bo'lgan xatolar ko'pincha yo'qoladi.

questions.question: Pyroscope / Parca bilan continuous profiling nima?
questions.explanation: Prod'dan CPU, allokatsiya va lock contention stack'larini past overhead'li eBPF (yoki SDK) bilan doimiy yig'ib flame graph'da ko'rsatish.

questions.question: Cilium Hubble tarmoq observability'sida nima beradi?
questions.explanation: eBPF bilan servislararo bog'liqlik grafi, tarmoq latency, TCP drop, DNS xatolari va HTTP status'larni ilova instrumentatsiyasisiz ko'rsatadi.

questions.question: SLO multi-window multi-burn-rate alerting (monitoring) qanday ishlaydi?
questions.explanation: Error budget yonish tezligi budget'ni xavfli muddatda tugatsa alert (masalan 14.4x burn rate 1h va 5m oynalarida — 30 kunlik budget'ning 2% i bir soatda ketadi → darhol page; 6x 6h/30m → page; sekinroqlari → ticket).

questions.question: Prometheus remote write va WAL nima?
questions.explanation: Sample'lar avval diskdagi WAL'ga yoziladi. Remote write ularni snappy-siqilgan protobuf bilan uzoq muddatli storage'ga (Mimir) stream qiladi; endpoint ishlamasa, WAL'dan (cheklangan vaqt ~2 soat) qayta yuboradi.

questions.question: Synthetic monitoring va RUM (monitoring kontekstida) farqi.
questions.explanation: Synthetic: bot'lar user journey'larni (checkout, login) muntazam bajarib, foydalanuvchidan oldin nosozlikni topadi.

questions.question: Vector va Fluent Bit nima?
questions.explanation: Rust (Vector) yoki C (Fluent Bit) da yozilgan yengil log forwarder'lar — node'larda DaemonSet sifatida container log'larini parse qilib Loki/Kafka/Elasticsearch'ga yuboradi.

questions.question: PromQL'da `predict_linear()` bilan diskni proaktiv alert qilish qanday?
questions.explanation: predict_linear(node_filesystem_free_bytes[4h], 24  3600) < 0

questions.question: Blackbox exporter nima?
questions.explanation: Tashqi endpoint'larni HTTP, HTTPS, DNS, TCP, ICMP orqali tekshiradi — mavjudlik, latency va SSL sertifikat muddati.

questions.question: Node exporter nima?
questions.explanation: Linux host'larning hardware va OS metrikalarini (CPU, xotira, disk I/O, tarmoq) Prometheus uchun chiqaradi.

questions.question: Kube-state-metrics (monitoring kontekstida) nima?
questions.explanation: API Server'ni tinglab Kubernetes obyektlari holati haqida metrikalar beradi (deployment replikalari, pod phase, limit'lar) — resurs sarfi emas, holat.

questions.question: OpenSearch va Elasticsearch farqi.
questions.explanation: OpenSearch — Elastic litsenziyani o'zgartirgandan (SSPL) keyin AWS va hamjamiyat yaratgan Elasticsearch va Kibana'ning Apache 2.0 fork'i (Elasticsearch keyinroq AGPL variantini ham qo'shdi).

questions.question: Strukturali (JSON) logging nima va nega majburiy?
questions.explanation: Log'larni JSON obyekt sifatida chiqarish ({"ts":"...","level":"info","user_id":"123"}) — mo'rt regex parsing yo'qoladi, maydonlar bo'yicha darhol filtr va indekslash.

questions.question: OpenTelemetry baggage nima?
questions.explanation: Trace konteksti bilan birga tarmoq chegaralari orqali ixtiyoriy key-value'larni (tenant_id="enterprise_456") uzatish — downstream servislar telemetriyaga biznes kontekst qo'sha oladi (sezgir ma'lumot qo'ymang — tashqa...

questions.question: Prometheus'da alert dedup va fingerprint nima?
questions.explanation: Alert'ning barcha label'laridan hash (fingerprint) hisoblanadi; Alertmanager HA juftlikdagi bir xil target'larni scrape qilayotgan Prometheus'lardan kelgan bir xil alert'larni shu bilan dedup qiladi.

questions.question: Grafana dashboard as code (jsonnet / grafonnet) nima?
questions.explanation: Dashboard'larni Jsonnet yoki TypeScript'da dasturiy yozish — versiyalash, review va CI/CD orqali deploy.

questions.question: `scrape_interval` va `evaluation_interval` farqi.
questions.explanation: scrape_interval: target'larni qanchalik tez-tez scrape qilish (masalan 15s).

questions.question: Prometheus recording rule nima?
questions.explanation: Tez-tez kerak bo'ladigan yoki qimmat PromQL ifodalarini oldindan hisoblab yangi series sifatida saqlash — dashboard tezlashadi:

questions.question: Prometheus TSDB block compaction nima?
questions.explanation: soatlik block'larni diskda kattaroq (retention'ning ~10% igacha) block'larga birlashtirish, chunk'larni siqish va o'chirilgan series'larni tozalash.

questions.question: Prometheus head block va persistent block farqi.
questions.explanation: Head block: xotiradagi joriy sample'lar (WAL bilan himoyalangan).

questions.question: Alertmanager silence nima?
questions.explanation: Rejali texnik ish paytida label matcher'lar (service="payment") bo'yicha alert xabarlarini vaqtincha o'chirish.

questions.question: Alertmanager routing tree nima?
questions.explanation: Label'larga ko'ra alert'larni turli receiver'larga (warning — Slack, critical — PagerDuty) yo'naltiruvchi ierarxik konfiguratsiya.

questions.question: Grafana Unified Alerting nima?
questions.explanation: Grafana ichidagi markaziy alert engine — turli manbalar (Prometheus, Loki, CloudWatch, PostgreSQL) bo'yicha alert'larni bitta UI/API'dan boshqarish.

questions.question: `relabel_configs` va `metric_relabel_configs` farqi.
questions.explanation: relabel_configs: scrape'dan oldin target metadata'si bo'yicha target'larni o'zgartirish/filtrlash.

questions.question: LogQL'da unwrap va agregatsiya nima?
questions.explanation: unwrap log maydonidagi son qiymatni metrika sifatida oladi (sum_over_time({app="api"} | json | unwrap duration_ms [5m])); unikal qiymatlarni sanash uchun maydon bo'yicha count by (...) ishlatiladi — yuqori cardinality...

questions.question: OpenTelemetry semantic conventions nima?
questions.explanation: Tillar bo'ylab telemetriya atributlari uchun standart nomlar (http.request.method, db.system, rpc.service) — dashboard va so'rovlar barcha servislarda ishlaydi.

questions.question: OTLP protokoli nima?
questions.explanation: OpenTelemetry'ning nativ uzatish protokoli: Protocol Buffers gRPC (4317) yoki HTTP (4318) orqali.

questions.question: Observability'da eBPF kernel probing nima?
questions.explanation: Kernel tracepoint va kprobe'larga sandbox bytecode biriktirib, bajarilish vaqti va paket drop'larini juda kichik overhead bilan o'lchash.

questions.question: Prometheus DeadMansSwitch (Watchdog) alert nima?
questions.explanation: Doim (24/7) ishlab turadigan alert; tashqi servisga (Dead Man's Snitch, PagerDuty heartbeat) yuboriladi — kelmay qolsa butun Prometheus → Alertmanager zanjiri ishlamayotgani bilinadi.

questions.question: Grafana Agent / Grafana Alloy nima?
questions.explanation: OTel va Prometheus asosidagi yengil kolektor — metrika, log, trace va profillarni bitta binary'da yig'adi (Agent'ning vorisi — Alloy).

questions.question: Span context nima?
questions.explanation: HTTP/gRPC header'larida process chegaralari orqali uzatiladigan o'zgarmas metadata: TraceID, SpanID, TraceFlags, TraceState.

questions.question: Loki log stream nima?
questions.explanation: Bir xil label to'plamiga ega log qatorlari ketma-ketligi; object storage'da siqilgan chunk'lar sifatida saqlanadi (label kombinatsiyasi = stream soni — cardinality).

questions.question: OTel auto-instrumentation va manual instrumentation farqi.
questions.explanation: Auto: bytecode/runtime'ni kod o'zgartirmasdan instrumentatsiya (Java agent, eBPF, Python monkey-patching).

questions.question: OTel resource attributes nima?
questions.explanation: Process chiqaradigan barcha telemetriyaga biriktiriladigan entity metadata (service.name="order-api", service.version, deployment.environment).

questions.question: Jaeger nima?
questions.explanation: Uber yaratgan ochiq CNCF distributed tracing platformasi — mikroservis tranzaksiyalarini kuzatish va debug qilish.

questions.question: Prometheus Pushgateway nima?
questions.explanation: Scrape qilinishidan oldin tugab qoladigan qisqa batch job'lar metrikalarini push qiladigan oraliq cache (doimiy servislar uchun ishlatmang — eskirgan metrikalar qoladi).

questions.question: Grafana variables (template so'rovlar) nima?
questions.explanation: Dashboard'dagi dinamik dropdown'lar — panellarni klaster, namespace, pod yoki region bo'yicha tez filtrlash.

questions.question: OTel Collector memory_limiter processor nima?
questions.explanation: Collector xotirasi chegaraga yaqinlashganda kiruvchi ma'lumotni rad etadi/sekinlashtiradi — OOM'ning oldini oladi (pipeline'da birinchi processor bo'lishi kerak).
